source.sqlReaderQuery:
WITH Years AS (
    SELECT 2012 AS Year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Year + 1
    FROM Years
    WHERE Year < 2026
)
SELECT
    Year,
    'https://api-ca.themortgageoffice.com/LSS.svc/GetLoansByTimestamp/'
    + FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(Year, 1, 1), 'MM-dd-yyyy') + ' 00:00:00/'
    + FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(Year, 12, 31), 'MM-dd-yyyy') + ' 23:59:59'
    AS ApiUrl
FROM Years
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
